intent_summary: Declared relationships require exact UTC timestamp alignment, shared cadence and entity scope, and compatible declared units.

criteria.criterion: Related datasets use identical normalized timestamps, the same declared cadence, and matching entity metadata.
criteria.notes: Parameterized assertions require specific errors for timestamp, cadence, and entity mismatches.

criteria.criterion: Relationship sources are timestamped and have unique timestamps; implicit resampling and duplicate aggregation are not accepted for lineage.
criteria.notes: Positional sources fail exact alignment; even an explicit duplicate-mean setting is rejected for relationship source lineage.

criteria.criterion: Difference relationships require identical declared source units and matching output units.
criteria.notes: Source and output unit checks are explicit. Tests cover mismatched source units and successful matching units.

criteria.criterion: An invalid relationship is reported as failed while valid sibling dataset results remain available.
criteria.notes: Relationship errors remain target-specific, healthy dataset results survive, and the overall mixed run is partial.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
